title: Research Design
intent: formative · Research & Retrieval (Doing) · click through the process
statement: Move from a vague question to an actionable, testable plan — structured before any data is collected.

steps.title: Define the gap and question
steps.text: Turn the gap in the literature into one precise, answerable research question.

steps.title: Set the scope
steps.text: Decide what can be studied and what must be deliberately left out.

steps.title: Choose the methodology
steps.text: Pick qualitative, quantitative or mixed methods — justified by the question, not habit.

steps.title: Define variables and hypotheses
steps.text: Name what you will measure and state your null and alternative hypotheses.

steps.title: Design the instruments
steps.text: Build the surveys, interviews or experiments that will actually collect the data.

feedForward.text: Draft your study in five lines: question, scope, method, variables, instrument. If any line is vague, the design is not ready.
